kpis.signal_en: Revenue increase driven by business growth
kpis.description_en: Total revenues of the company, primarily generated by advisory services in mergers and acquisitions

kpis.signal_en: Continuously increasing international revenues over three years
kpis.description_en: Revenues generated by the company's international operations across the Americas, Europe, Middle East, and Asia-Pacific
kpis.explanation_en: Revenues generated by the company's international activities

kpis.signal_en: Stable compensation ratio despite revenue growth
kpis.description_en: Employee compensation and benefits expenses as a percentage of total revenues (Employee Compensation and Benefits / Revenues = 1,524,268K / 2,389,416K)
kpis.explanation_en: Ratio of employee compensation and benefits expenses to revenues

kpis.description_en: Operating income reached $501.5M for the fiscal year ended March 2025, up 38% versus $362.9M in 2024. This growth reflects operating leverage on revenue expansion
kpis.explanation_en: Profit generated after deduction of all operating expenses, before taxes and other income

kpis.description_en: The Corporate Finance segment represented 63.9% of total revenues in FY2025 ($1.53B out of $2.39B), compared to 57.8% in FY2024 ($1.11B out of $1.91B). The recovery in M&A markets amplifies this weight
kpis.explanation_en: Proportion of total revenues generated by the Corporate Finance segment, an indicator of sector concentration

kpis.description_en: Non-compensation expenses represented 15.2% of revenues in FY2025 ($363.6M / $2,389.4M), compared to 17.6% in FY2024 ($338.0M / $1,914.4M). The dilution of these fixed costs illustrates operating leverage
kpis.explanation_en: Share of non-compensation expenses (IT, rent, amortization, fees) relative to total revenues

kpis.description_en: Unrestricted cash and marketable securities reached $1.17B as of March 31, 2025, compared to $759.2M a year earlier (+54%). This increase is driven by strong operating cash generation during the fiscal year
kpis.explanation_en: Sum of unrestricted cash and marketable securities, reflecting the group's immediate financial capacity

kpis.description_en: The Corporate Finance segment closed 564 transactions in FY2025 versus 450 in FY2024, a 25% increase. This record volume reflects the recovery in M&A markets and directly supports segment revenue growth
kpis.explanation_en: Number of transactions successfully completed in the Corporate Finance segment, a key M&A activity indicator

kpis.signal_en: Dividend per share of $0.6 in the latest year
kpis.description_en: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last seven fiscal years reported by the company

kpis.signal_en: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $0.165B in the latest year
kpis.description_en: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last four reported fiscal years

kpis.signal_en: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 41.3% in the latest year
kpis.description_en: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last four fiscal years using data from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt

hero_kpi_rationale_en: Master indicator for the investment banking advisory services sector, directly reflecting demand for M&A transactions and financial restructuring services

ai_positioning.summary_en: The company HLI has not mentioned artificial intelligence or machine learning in the provided excerpts from its 10-K/20-F filing. Therefore, its position on these technologies is not identifiable from this information.

risks.title: Volatile Market
risks.summary_en: Market conditions can affect the volume and size of transactions, potentially reducing the company's revenues. Factors such as access to credit markets, high interest rates, inflation, and economic uncertainty directly impact M&A and financial restructuring advisory activities
risks.score_rationale_en: The company is exposed to market fluctuations, which can impact its revenue and earnings. Economic and market conditions may reduce the volume and size of advisory transactions (Item 1A Risk Factors)

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.summary_en: Heightened competition may reduce the company's market share and impact its financial results in M&A, restructuring, and valuation advisory services
risks.score_rationale_en: The company operates in a highly specialized and competitive independent investment banking environment

risks.title: Credit Risks
risks.summary_en: Credit risks may reduce the company's revenues and impact its financial results, particularly in financial restructuring services
risks.score_rationale_en: The company is exposed to credit risks related to client commitments and market conditions

risks.title: Regulation
risks.summary_en: Regulatory changes may affect the company's financial results, particularly in compliance, data protection, and international trade policies
risks.score_rationale_en: The company is subject to strict financial services industry regulations

risks.title: Geopolitical Risk
risks.summary_en: Geopolitical events, military conflicts, international trade policies, and global trade disruptions may reduce the company's revenues and impact its financial results
risks.score_rationale_en: The company is exposed to geopolitical risks, including military conflicts in Eastern Europe and the Middle East that affect transactions and market conditions (Item 1A Risk Factors)

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.summary_en: Cyberattacks and malicious campaigns may reduce the company's revenues, damage its reputation, and impact its financial results
risks.score_rationale_en: The company is exposed to cybersecurity risks as a financial services provider handling sensitive information

risks.title: International Dependence
risks.summary_en: International operations across 35 global offices may be affected by geopolitical events, currency fluctuations, trade policies, and local regulations
risks.score_rationale_en: The company relies significantly on international operations, generating 28.7% of its revenues from non-U.S. activities ($687M out of $2.39B)

risks.title: In addition, we face the possibility of an actual, potential or perceived conflict of interest where we represent a client on a transaction in which an existing client is a party
